scope: Direct saved-shot origin, with explicit keeper identity and whole-match shot coverage; never saves minus inside saves
selection: All current outside-box-save gap fixtures plus first 20 non-target 2025/26 fixtures by FPL fixture ID
eligibility: Verified date, clubs, full score, match and Opta-player identity
Explicit non-own-goal shot inventory equals explicit full-match total shots for both clubs
Every candidate keeper save has explicit blocked, off-line and on-target flags, origin flag and keeper ID
Save keeper belongs to opponent club; keeper ID resolves uniquely to player Opta code
Candidate save count equals authoritative FPL saves and explicit FotMob keeper saves for the same player-match
Only eligible controls compare known outside counts; failed eligibility is an abstention, never zero
rules: Count AttemptSaved, not blocked, not saved off line, on target, not own goal, with explicit keeperId.
Outside count uses explicit isFromInsideBox=false on those keeper saves.
Missing flags, unknown identity, incomplete shots, inconsistent saves and any known outside-count conflict veto application.
Preserve closed rows and all unresolved conflicts; no scoring or bonus qualification.
